visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white tank top with red trim and denim shorts, sits at a wooden table inside a restaurant. She performs a 'Wai' greeting (palms together) towards the camera. Behind her is a framed painting of a seafood soup bowl and a informational poster. The lighting is bright and warm. (2) The scene cuts to several close-up shots of seafood dishes on the wooden table, including marinated raw salmon, marinated raw crabs in sauce with chili, and a large grilled river prawn served with green and red dipping sauces. The camera is static and focused on the food textures. (3) A hand uses a fork to pull a large piece of lobster meat from its shell; the lobster is covered in melted, stringy cheese. The background shows the restaurant setting with other plates and condiments. (4) The woman is shown again, holding a crab shell filled with roe and butter. She uses a spoon to scoop a generous portion and eats it with a satisfied, eyes-closed expression. She is seated in the same brightly lit restaurant. (5) The camera captures a large oyster on a plate. The woman squeezes a fresh lemon wedge over it, then lifts the shell and slides the oyster into her mouth. She nods her head and makes hand gestures indicating the food is delicious. (6) A transition occurs where a close-up of a piece of durian fruit wrapped in tissue paper is shown, with the yellow fruit appearing creamy and fibrous. (7) The scene shifts dramatically to a dimly lit hotel room. The woman is now lying in bed on a white pillow, wearing a black sweatshirt. She looks visibly tired and pale, talking directly to the camera with a weak smile. She holds up a box of 'Greater CA-R-BON' medicine in front of her face briefly. (8) The woman continues to talk to the camera while lying down, gesturing with her hands. The background is a plain white wall and the headboard of the bed. The lighting is soft and natural from the room's interior.
